chunks: So, I call the receding stars to witness,

key_terms.الْخُنَّسِ: The receding stars (specifically planets or stars that set)

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Al-Khunnas' refer to in Surah Al-Takwir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Khunnas' (stars that withdraw) are often interpreted not merely as celestial bodies but as symbols of the transient nature of worldly power and the eventual concealment of the Imams, reinforcing the certainty of divine retribution. This oath underscores the cosmic scale of the 'Overthrowing' (Takwir), linking astronomical phenomena to the spiritual reality of the Hereafter and serving as a rhetorical device to silence the disbelievers of Mecca.
